recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a male vocalist in a suit and turtleneck, set against a warm, blurred, golden-brown background. The composition features bold, slanted sans-serif typography in the upper left quadrant, utilizing a high-contrast color palette of white and yellow against the dark suit and warm backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's gaze directed off-camera creates a sense of aspiration and warmth.
The heavy, slanted typography mirrors the diagonal lines of the subject's shoulders.
Warm golden highlights on the face and background contrast with the cool dark blue of the suit jacket.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally but occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, creating space for text above.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, illuminated by a warm key light.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white name in the top left, moves down to the yellow sub-header, then follows the subject's shoulder line to his face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant breathing room in the upper left and right corners for metadata and branding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ambers in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue of the suit jacket provides a dark base for the composition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for secondary text and white for primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and dark suit; low saturation in the background to emphasize the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, navy, white, and yellow

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century grotesque or gothic structures

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark shoulder area
placed over the dark shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights, cases, and colors to establish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century weight and terminal style.
Provides the necessary width and clean geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a 1960s male singer in a dark navy suit and white turtleneck. Lighting should be warm and golden, coming from the side. The background should be a soft-focus, textured wall in shades of amber and brown. Leave the top left quadrant relatively dark and uncluttered.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main name in large, white, all-caps, heavy italicized sans-serif at the top left. Directly underneath, add a secondary word in medium-sized, yellow, lowercase, bold italicized sans-serif. Add a list of song titles in small, white, left-aligned sans-serif below that.

verificationChecks: Is the main text white and all-caps?
Is the secondary text yellow and lowercase?
Is the overall color palette warm and sepia-toned?
Is the subject wearing a turtleneck under a suit jacket?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the golden background glow
Specific shade of the yellow accent text
Degree of the italic slant in the typography
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
Record label logos in the corners
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Authentic 1960s film grain and color grading
Balanced composition between text and portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check for correct color hierarchy (White > Yellow > White)
Ensure the text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the 'vintage print' texture is present
Confirm the subject's pose feels candid and warm
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-lit mid-century portrait with heavy, slanted sans-serif typography in a left-aligned block for a classic 1960s vocal pop aesthetic.
